epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container startup failure rate from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: Update the unresolved minio Docker image tag to a resolvable version

slices.title: Update MinIO Docker image tag
slices.jtbd: When implementing the image tag fix for this epic, I want to update the minio version to a stable resolvable release, so that the object storage container can start successfully and unblock the environment.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose environment, When the object-storage service is configured, Then the minio image has a resolvable tag.
Given the system needs to run locally, When docker-compose up is executed, Then there are no image resolution errors for minio.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce image pull failure rate for minio from 100% to 0%
